Lead Israel from Rameses to Mount Nebo in this retro journey game. Buy supplies, set your pace and rations, answer the people's grumbling, survive attacks, and cross the water with Moses. You can save at any camp.

## Download

- **Windows:** Download `TheExodus-Windows.zip`, unzip it, and open `TheExodus.exe`. If SmartScreen appears, choose **More info**, then **Run anyway**.
- **macOS:** Download `TheExodus-macOS.zip`, unzip it, then Control-click the app and choose **Open**.
- **Linux:** Download `TheExodus-Linux.tar.gz`, then run `tar -xzf TheExodus-Linux.tar.gz` and `./TheExodus`.

The apps are not code-signed, so your system may warn you the first time you open one.
